messages.subject: Re: I have  a question about the software "CODEX"
parts:
Hi

Thanks for your interest in CODEX. CODEX/CODEX2 cannot be used for single-cell analysis.

Yuchao

On May 28, 2019, at 3:34 PM, 涂志伟 <tuzww...@163.com> wrote:

Dear professor Jiang:
    Excuse me ! My name is Zhiwei Tu,I'm a bio-worker who has just graduated. I have a problem about the software “CODEX”，I have install the R packages “CODEX”，and some relate R packages . I try to running the code which supply  by guide file.Fortunatly！It is successful to running and get the results. But the code is use to multiple samples analysis which from introduction document.I try to change the code ,To test whether the code is usefull to single sample analysis.Although modifying the code wasn't as expected, but it was done in the end.However,the single analysis can't give a right result.I can't get the information about that whether "CODEX" can use to single sample analysis. So,I have to ask for you whether “CODEX”can use to single sample analysis.wish  you can reply my email !
Thanks!
Best wish!


尊敬教授：
    您好，我叫涂志伟，我是一名刚刚毕业的生物工作人员。我有一个关于“CODEX”的问题需要向您请教一下。我目前已经在R软件安装好“CODEX”这个R包以及相关的R包，我根据指南文档尝试运行里面的一些命令。幸运的是，这些代码能顺利运行并且得到正确的结果，但是由于介绍文档中代码是用于多样本分析，我尝试修改代码，看看CODEX能否用于单样本分析，虽然修改代码碰到一些问题，但是最后还是完成了，然而，最终结果是错误的。我无法从文档中获取关于CODEX是否可以用于单样本分析，因此，我不得不向您请问下：“CODEX可以用于单样本分析吗？”，希望能收到您的回信。
谢谢！
祝好！
